report:
Reviewed the complete fresh crates.sage_ir.types.body.no_inference claim, both implementation associations and both associated tests. Requirements are absence of live inference variables and unresolved semantic choices from successful completed bodies, resolution of type edges during completion, and a final tree independent of temporary inference state. Captured design/RFD context and the relevant egraph, unification setup and Stashed helpers.

finalize.rs implements a fresh target stash and recursively rebuilds the body. copy_ty follows ROOT egraph representatives before copying, recursively visits compound types and alias arguments, memoizes results and rejects an unresolved InferVar or recursive type. copy_expr resolves expression slots before copying data and guards recursive slots; expression-data copying rejects an Unresolved case as unreachable. Statement annotations, pattern types, match guards/bodies, closure parameters, call dispatch Self/trait arguments and owner/method substitutions are recursively copied. Thus completion resolves nested type edges and expression-slot indirections instead of returning the working stash. The fresh Stashed value owns the target storage.

infer_ctx.rs finish checks no pending obligations, live inference branch, active runtime task or unpublished wake remains; it requires all expression slots filled, consumes the working context, invokes the finalizer and returns the body and diagnostics. The preceding finalize path diagnoses unresolved variables into reported error types and terminally discharges obligations. Those checks distinguish a successful completed product from suspended inference machinery. These implementation entries support the completion boundary; they are not an exhaustive proof for every source construct. The finalizer still carries transitional source-shaped variants, so broader semantic-choice rejection is not inferred merely from its type-edge traversal.

The ordinary finalized_nested_body_owns_resolved_and_imported_types_after_sources_drop test constructs an imported Bool, an inference variable unified with it, and a nested tuple containing both a direct child and an unresolved slot pointing to that child. It asserts that source inference and expression-slot representations remain unchanged after finalization, then explicitly drops the egraph, source stash and imported value before opening the result. It verifies both tuple type elements are Bool, both expression elements resolve to the same final child, and each child's data/type/span is the expected Bool literal/Bool/original span. It also checks root/body spans and empty locals. These are direct substantive assertions of resolved nested edges, slot elimination, nonmutation and independence from temporary owners. The test does not call finish or exercise all body shapes, every pending-choice class, or failure guards; no such coverage is claimed.

The sole TODO test, sage_meta::todo::types_body_no_inference, has no assertions and explicitly retains completion fixtures traversing the entire returned tree and rejecting live inference/unresolved choices. Its prerequisites are the broader completion/elaboration paths and whole-tree fixtures, including less common nested type positions and unresolved-choice rejection. It appropriately limits the ordinary nested-tuple case rather than treating that case as a universal matrix. No N/A exemption or weakened successful-body requirement is used.

Helper inspection confirms egraph find follows parent representatives; try_unify delegates the setup equality to its atomic batch path; Stashed copy_into copies into the supplied stash, while new owns the provided stash and open_deref accesses that owned root. The test itself observes actual final values after dropping sources, so its ownership and resolution assertions do not rely solely on helper names.

Validation was source inspection of fresh inputs and review-read dependencies. No source edits or behavioral tests were performed; coordinator-run suites remain separate evidence. No requested edits: the current completion implementation and meaningful ordinary test are supported, while the broader semantic-choice/whole-tree test matrix remains explicitly deferred.
